statement: Producer four-point native functional controls at actual Curve25519 p,A and M=1: std(dp), std(lp) and bounded native root recovery return one assignment and one checked signed sum for the member target, and a unit basis with no sums for the nonmember target, both matching the complete singleton-base oracle. Each native process is limited to four CPU seconds, five wall seconds and 768 MiB. Nine unit tests plus one process-level test pass, including actual four-coset known-assignment recovery, mutation and mixed-protocol controls. The 454-variable full-base public solver script was prepared without running it. No timing, absence certificate, uniform-yield, changed-exponent or geometric proof claim.
